subject: AI 与科技日报 2026-11-06 · Daily AI & Tech Brief
headline_zh: 美股AI板块单日蒸发2.5万亿美元；中期选举后民主党喊停数据中心；巴拉圭总统因银行倒闭辞职
headline_en: AI stocks shed $2.5 trillion in a historic rout; Democrats push a data center moratorium after midterms; Paraguay's president resigns over a bank collapse.

items.title_zh: AI 股遭历史性抛售，纳斯达克一日蒸发 2.5 万亿美元
items.title_en: AI selloff wipes $2.5 trillion off Nasdaq in a single day
items.body_zh: 美国中期选举结果出来后，投资者对数据中心建设和 AI 投资可能面临更严监管的担忧升温，科技股集体重挫。据路透和《华尔街日报》报道，纳斯达克单日市值蒸发约 2.5 万亿美元，被称为华尔街对 AI 交易的一次“现实检验”。
items.body_en: Investors dumped tech stocks after the US midterms raised the prospect of tougher scrutiny of data center construction and AI spending. Roughly $2.5 trillion was wiped off the Nasdaq in a single session, a rout Reuters and the Wall Street Journal described as a reality check for the AI trade.

items.title_zh: 民主党高层呼吁全国暂停数据中心建设
items.title_en: Top Democrats call for a national data center moratorium
items.body_zh: 中期选举大胜后，民主党高层公开呼吁“立即全国暂停数据中心建设”，把 AI 基建推上政治议程。Meta 此前已警告，选举带来的反弹可能拖慢其 AI 扩张。
items.body_en: After their midterm sweep, senior Democrats publicly called for a national moratorium on data center construction, putting AI infrastructure squarely on the political agenda. Meta had already warned that election-year backlash could slow its AI expansion.

items.title_zh: 得州 AI 数据中心热潮或因蓝潮受挫
items.title_en: Texas's AI data center boom may be derailed by the blue wave
items.body_zh: 得州是美国增长最快的数据中心市场，也是大厂 AI 基建的核心地带。但民主党人 James Talarico 赢下参议员席位、Gina Hinojosa 赢下州长选举，可能让这一地位生变。
items.body_en: Texas is the fastest-growing data center market in the US and ground zero for Big Tech's AI buildouts. But Democrat James Talarico won a Senate seat and Gina Hinojosa won the governor's race, which could put that position at risk.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Cyber，称发现火狐 81 个新漏洞
items.title_en: OpenAI launches GPT-6 Cyber, claims 81 new Firefox bugs found
items.body_zh: OpenAI 推出网络安全专用模型 GPT-6 Cyber，在 ExploitGym 基准上得分 48.5%，较上一代 GPT-5.6 Cyber 的 32.1% 相对提升约 51%。OpenAI 称该模型在火狐浏览器中发现 81 个新漏洞，并强调在无安全提示时 99.93% 的测试未越出授权范围。
items.body_en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, a security-focused model that scored 48.5% on the ExploitGym benchmark, up about 51% from GPT-5.6 Cyber's 32.1%. OpenAI says it found 81 new vulnerabilities in Firefox and that 99.93% of tests stayed within authorized scope without safety prompts.

items.title_zh: Perplexity 推出常驻 AI 同事“Teammates”
items.body_zh: Perplexity 发布面向工作的常驻 AI 智能体“Teammates”，可在同一工作区内承担多种角色，并调用用户已有的项目、技能和记忆。它接入 Perplexity Computer，直接对标 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的企业智能体。
items.body_en: Perplexity launched 'Teammates', always-on AI agents for work that can take on multiple roles in a workspace and pull in existing projects, skills and memory. Integrated with Perplexity Computer, the product takes direct aim at OpenAI and Anthropic's enterprise agents.

items.title_zh: 百度开源文心 5.5 Flash Base
items.body_zh: 百度 11 月 5 日正式开源基座模型文心 5.5 Flash Base，官方称在多项基准测试中刷新同尺寸模型 SOTA。这是国内大厂在开源权重路线上的又一次加码。
items.body_en: Baidu open-sourced its ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base model on November 5, claiming state-of-the-art results among same-sized models on multiple benchmarks. It marks another push by a major Chinese player into open-weight releases.

items.title_zh: 英伟达：HBM 仅增约 3%，每美元智能体吞吐量最高提升 30 倍
items.title_en: Nvidia: 3% more HBM, up to 30x agent throughput per dollar
items.body_zh: 英伟达发布技术解读，称通过 GPU、CPU、网络、存储和软件的全栈协同设计，在 HBM 容量仅增加约 3% 的情况下，每美元智能体吞吐量最高提升 30 倍。背景是 HBM 供应趋紧、价格上行，显存成为 AI 推理的瓶颈。
items.body_en: Nvidia published a technical note saying full-stack co-design across GPU, CPU, networking, storage and software can lift agent throughput per dollar by up to 30x with only about 3% more HBM. The pitch comes as tight HBM supply and rising prices make memory the bottleneck for AI inference.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 被指在“放缓”呼声中加速 AI 研发
items.title_en: Anthropic accused of accelerating AI work amid slowdown calls
items.body_zh: 据 AP 报道，一家外部研究机构称 Anthropic 正在快速推进 AI 研发，与外界呼吁放缓的声音相悖。报道未给出具体研发节点，相关说法尚待更多信源确认。
items.body_en: An outside research group says Anthropic is rapidly accelerating its AI development despite calls for a slowdown, according to AP. The report did not detail specific milestones, and the claim awaits further confirmation.

items.title_zh: 纽约时报洽谈以约 3.3 亿美元收购 Letterboxd
items.title_en: New York Times in talks to buy Letterboxd for about $330 million
items.body_zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，纽约时报公司正就收购影迷社交网络 Letterboxd 进行独家谈判，价格约 3.3 亿美元。索尼影视和 A24 此前也被传有意竞购。
items.body_en: The New York Times Company is in exclusive talks to acquire film-lovers' social network Letterboxd for around $330 million, the Times reported. Sony Pictures and A24 had also been rumored to be interested.

items.title_zh: 美国政府警告工业、零售和军用冷柜遭大规模黑客攻击
items.title_en: US warns of mass hacks hitting industrial, retail and military freezers
items.body_zh: 美国政府联合声明称，这轮黑客攻击已波及食品、交通和医疗行业，构成“持续的网络威胁”。此前有报道称全球范围内出现大规模冷柜设备被入侵。
items.body_en: A joint US government statement warned of an 'ongoing cyber threat' after mass hacks of freezers affected the food, transportation and healthcare sectors. The warning follows reports of large-scale compromises of refrigeration equipment worldwide.

items.title_zh: Airbnb 将于 2027 年上半年推出 AI 旅行代理
items.title_en: Airbnb to launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
items.body_zh: Airbnb 在财报相关表态中称，其 AI 代理将帮助旅客规划行程、比较选项、管理预订，并在入住期间提供协助。上线时间定在 2027 年上半年。
items.body_en: Airbnb said its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings and get help during their stay. The company put the launch in the first half of 2027.

items.title_zh: 巴拉圭总统培尼亚因银行倒闭辞职
items.title_en: Paraguay's President Peña resigns after bank collapse
items.body_zh: 巴拉圭总统圣地亚哥·培尼亚周四辞职，此前该国银行体系崩溃、数百万民众储蓄被冻结，众议院投票支持启动弹劾程序。危机中心是 Ueno Bank，培尼亚政府曾批准其大幅扩张业务。
items.body_en: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña resigned on Thursday after the country's banking system collapsed and millions of people's savings were frozen, with the lower house voting to pursue impeachment. The crisis centered on Ueno Bank, which Peña's government had allowed to expand sharply.

items.title_zh: 欧洲多国航班再遭炸弹威胁，至少 21 架受影响
items.title_en: Bomb hoaxes hit European flights again, at least 21 affected
items.body_zh: 欧洲多国航空公司和机场一周内第二次收到炸弹威胁，至少 21 架航班受影响，英国政府称这是“恶意虚假威胁”。有报道称受影响航班超过 25 架，引发对混合战的担忧。
items.body_en: Airlines and airports across Europe received bomb threats for the second time in a week, with at least 21 flights affected in what the UK government called 'malicious hoax threats'. Some reports put the number above 25, fueling fears of hybrid warfare.

items.title_zh: 法国抗议人数激增，工会加入高生活成本罢工
items.title_en: French protests surge as unions join cost-of-living strikes
items.body_zh: 法国内政部估计全国约 60 万人参加抗议，工会方面称人数远高于此。示威聚焦高生活成本，工会加入后规模明显扩大。
items.body_en: France's interior ministry estimated 600,000 people joined protests nationwide, while unions said the figure was far higher. The demonstrations over the high cost of living grew noticeably after unions joined.

items.title_zh: LIV Golf 融资救援失败，启动破产清算
items.title_en: LIV Golf to liquidate after rescue financing collapses
items.body_zh: LIV Golf 的破产程序已在新泽西法院启动，联盟计划关闭。DP World Tour 表示预计明年将迎来一批 LIV 球员，并准备向包括 Bryson DeChambeau 在内的“叛逆者”伸出橄榄枝。
items.body_en: Bankruptcy proceedings for LIV Golf began in a New Jersey court, and the league plans to shut down. The DP World Tour said it expects an influx of LIV players next year and is ready to welcome back former rebels including Bryson DeChambeau.

items.title_zh: C 罗宣布退出葡萄牙国家队
items.title_en: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
items.body_zh: C 罗正式从葡萄牙国家队退役，BBC 称其为“改变了葡萄牙的偶像”。报道回顾了他的国家队生涯，并讨论其下一步去向。
items.body_en: Cristiano Ronaldo has retired from international football, with the BBC calling him 'the icon who transformed Portugal'. The report looks back at his national-team career and what comes next.

quick_zh: Salon 宣布停刊，这家上线 31 年的纯数字新闻杂志称独立数字媒体的商业模式已发生深刻变化。
加州州长减免该州 548 名死囚的刑期，加州死囚人数历来为全美最多。
英国一名在刚果（金）的医护工作者因感染埃博拉被撤回英国治疗，目前情况稳定。
quick_en: Salon is shutting down after 31 years, saying the business realities of independent digital journalism have changed profoundly.
California's governor commuted the sentences of the state's 548 death row inmates; California has historically had the largest death row population in the US.
A British healthcare worker in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has been evacuated to the UK for Ebola treatment and is in stable condition.
